## 2025-01-22 - Markdown Internal Linking with Emojis
**Learning:** When using emojis in Markdown headers (e.g., `## 📈 Stats`), standard auto-generated anchors can be unpredictable or stripped. Explicit HTML anchors (`<a id="stats"></a>`) are required to ensure reliable Table of Contents navigation.
**Action:** Always use explicit inline HTML anchors for headers containing emojis or special characters if a TOC is involved.
